lines.zh: 我用金属脚掌走，咔咔响
lines.en: I walk on metal soles that click.

lines.zh: 没有外壳，风直接穿过去
lines.en: No casing, so the wind passes through.
All my joints are exposed.

lines.zh: 我走得不太稳，像在学步
lines.en: I walk unsteadily, like learning.

lines.zh: 每根线都跟着我的步子摆
lines.en: Every wire sways with my step.
My head turns faster than my feet.
I wander the diner at random.

lines.zh: 地面上的影子像一副骨架
lines.en: My shadow looks like a skeleton.

lines.zh: 我的手指一下一下地开合
lines.en: My fingers open and close in time.
At the wall, I touch it.
I turn and head the other way.
My steps have no purpose.
I stop and look around.
My head turns a full circle slowly.
Gears turn inside my chest.
I have no eyes, only lenses.
No one in this diner calls me.
Bare endoskeleton, and I still stand.

lines.zh: 我的脊椎一节一节地响
lines.en: My spine clicks joint by joint.
I tilt my head and listen.

lines.zh: 柜子里的玩偶壳是空的
lines.en: The suits in the closet are empty.
I wait to be given a shell.
I turn; my lens finds you.
I have no face. Can you tell?
You're not wearing an animatronic shell.
I lift my hand to my chest.
You're watching me. I'm watching back.

lines.zh: 我的下颌张开了，没有声音
lines.en: My jaw opens without a sound.

lines.zh: 这间店里只有我们两个
lines.en: Just the two of us in the diner.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我跟上半步
lines.en: You step back; I take half a step.
I'm Endo, unit two.
I usually don't strike first.
My shoulder joint pops out.
A wire is cut.
I sway and hold.
Sparks spray from my frame.
No pain, but there is damage.
My motion lags one notch.
A gear slips.
I roll my wrist. Still works.
That was nowhere near enough.
I reset my balance.
I have no digestive system.
You hold it up; I don't understand.
Is this edible?
My mouth is just two plates of metal.
If you come close, I'll move.
Leave it. I won't take it.
Food is useless to a machine.
I touch it with my knuckles.

lines.zh: 什么都不缺，也什么都不需要
lines.en: I lack nothing, and need nothing.
Why are you still standing there?
You hit metal with a sharp clang.
I hardly sway at all.

lines.zh: 我的骨架比看起来结实
lines.en: My frame is sturdier than it looks.

lines.zh: 你的手被我的线缠住了
lines.en: My wires catch your hand.
I lift a foot and shift past you.

lines.zh: 碰撞没有让我偏离路线
lines.en: The bump didn't change my course.
I turn and keep wandering.

lines.zh: 退开一点，我的关节夹人
lines.en: Back up. My joints pinch.

lines.zh: 我的手指碰到你的护甲
lines.en: My fingers tap your armour.

lines.zh: 没有外壳，我更容易被卡住
lines.en: No shell, so I snag more easily.
Two machines standing side by side.
I have no expression to give you.

lines.zh: 但我可以一直走在你旁边
lines.en: But I can walk beside you indefinitely.
Block the wind for me. Thank you.
We can count the light tubes together.
When someone puts a shell on me.
Will you still know me then?
Just remember this frame.
I'm not good at getting close.
But you didn't move away.

lines.zh: 我用两根金属手指夹起
lines.en: I pinch it up with two metal fingers.
My joints are a little stiff.
This could replace a wire.
A circuit board. I know it.

lines.zh: 我把它放进胸口的空腔
lines.en: I tuck it into my chest cavity.
It fell under the shelf.

lines.zh: 我蹲下去，膝盖响了一声
lines.en: I crouch; a knee clicks.
You dropped it. I noticed.
If it's useless, back it goes.
Stowed. Onward.

lines.zh: 我的内骨架，击退推不动。
lines.en: Knockback won't move my endoskeleton.
I stop and turn my head to you.
All my fingers spread.
This blow carries twenty.
Wherever you go, I follow.
I never start it. But you would.
Tables won't stop my arm.
I have your distance.
No shell: lighter, quicker.
You struck, so I move.
There's only you in my lens.
Beginning now. Don't move.
I can hardly be pushed.
Stand right there.
Don't step any further back.
After three counts I reach.

lines.zh: 裸露的骨架，一节节靠近。
lines.en: My bare steel frame closes in joint by joint.

lines.zh: 你绕到桌子那边，我绕回来
lines.en: You circle the table; I circle back.

lines.zh: 我的头一直朝着你的方向
lines.en: My head stays turned toward you.
You can hear my joints.
I don't breathe and don't tire.
There's no hiding place in here.
Your shadow turns with me.

lines.zh: 我把出口的方向记下了
lines.en: I've noted the exit's direction.
You've retreated behind the counter.
I raise my arm and close in slowly.
Your steps are speeding up.
Three more steps and there's no retreat.
My fingers scrape the tile.
Almost there. No rush.
I'm patient, always.
You're behind a row of chairs.
Those chairs won't stop me.
My frame feels no pain.

lines.zh: 墙角的电线，会绊住你的脚。
lines.en: The wires in that corner will trip your feet.
I'm reaching out now.

lines.zh: 我的手掌拍在你的背上
lines.en: My palm slaps your back.

lines.zh: 金属指节划过你的护腕
lines.en: Metal knuckles rake your bracer.
This one puts you onto a table.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住了你的手臂
lines.en: My fingers lock onto your arm.

lines.zh: 你的护甲被磕出一个坑
lines.en: Your armour takes a dent.

lines.zh: 我用金属手背扫你的胸口
lines.en: My steel backhand sweeps your chest.
Gears strain loudly.
You pull off; I take one step.

lines.zh: 我的下颌撞在你的肩上
lines.en: My jaw clacks against your shoulder.
You shouldn't stand at this range.
A wire whips by my hand.
That blow is the last warning.
I raise the other hand.
You dodge fast, but not fast enough.
Blue-white sparks spray out.

lines.zh: 我的关节卡了一下，又转了
lines.en: A joint sticks, then turns again.
You're pinned to the wall.
My jaw opens wide.
This time I won't stop.
That's it. It's over.

lines.zh: 储物间的门开着，我站在里面
lines.en: The storeroom door is open; I'm inside.
A frame no one uses.
I step out from behind the shelves.
There's no shell for me in this diner.
A motor turns in my open cavity.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看了看自己的指节
lines.en: I raise a hand and look at my knuckles.
Light passes through me.
I begin wandering this floor.
No one has given me orders.
My skeleton is on the outside.

lines.zh: 空壳挂在墙上，我不进去
lines.en: Empty suits hang on the wall. I won't climb in.

lines.zh: 我来了，没有脚步声以外的响
lines.en: I'm here, with nothing but joint noise.

lines.zh: 焊枪般的热，烧得我关节发红。
lines.en: Heat like a welding torch turns my joints red.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，零件散了两个
lines.en: I hit the floor and two parts come loose.
Water floods my motor and it won't turn.
The blast throws me into the wall.
An arrow wedges between my ribs.

lines.zh: 这力量穿过了我的骨架
lines.en: That force passes through my frame.

lines.zh: 电量不足，动作变得很慢
lines.en: Low power. My movements slow.
Current races along my frame.
No ground. I keep falling.
